column7: a PARTIAL key-material set -- some required key files present, some missing -- refuses to start. Decidable from os.Stat alone and cannot be fooled by how the files were copied in. The mixed-generation half (a complete set whose files come from different generations) is its own row, ADR-112-KEYFILE-SET-MIXED-GENERATION-REFUSES-BOOT, enforced by the key-set manifest (#2900), which replaced the best-effort mtime heuristic
